approvals.name: generate_image

args.name: Start where you are — fitness coach

style.prompt: Create an upbeat polished social media photograph featuring a smiling adult female fitness coach in a bright airy fitness studio with large windows, soft natural daylight, light neutral walls, a few subtly visible fitness mats and plants. She wears colorful tasteful athletic wear, looks confident, friendly and approachable, waist-up portrait, realistic photography with fresh warm colors. Place the exact headline “Start where you are” at the very top in large clear bold modern dark teal lettering, within generous safe margins, on an uncluttered pale background area. Her entire head and face must be well below the headline, with no text overlapping her face. This headline is the ONLY text: no logos, watermarks, labels, or other writing. Keep the overall composition centered and leave generous empty space at both sides so it can be cropped to a 4:5 portrait without cutting the headline or subject.
